name: task-time-tracker
description: Task & Time Tracker - a personal productivity SaaS application

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit -w apps/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test:api -w apps/api
scripts.test:authorization: npm run build:shared && npm run test:authorization -w apps/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
